description: Generic NES game profile. Maps the universal action vocabulary to the standard NES two-face-button layout. Suitable as a vision-only default for any NES title without a game-specific profile.

confirm.hint: Press A. Advance dialog, confirm menu choice, fire in shooters, primary action in platformers.

cancel.hint: Press B. Cancel menu, secondary action (jump in some games, special in others).

menu.hint: Press Start. Open the pause / inventory menu in most games; start the game on the title screen.

back.hint: Press Select. Game-specific: typically swaps weapons or opens a secondary menu (rarely used outside RPGs and Metroid).

nav_up.hint: Walk / fly / move up. In menus: cursor up.

nav_down.hint: Walk / move down. In menus: cursor down.

nav_left.hint: Walk / move left. In menus: cursor left.

nav_right.hint: Walk / move right. In menus: cursor right.

notes: Per-game profiles should override action hints to describe the in-game effect (e.g. 'confirm = jump' for Super Mario Bros.); the universal verbs still describe the player's intent.
